decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield integration does not change the established automatic direct-wallet prize delivery behavior.
The referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic wallet payout are independent of Aave integration.
The FAQ state at this time contains no Aave or prize-pool yield claim requiring removal.
The Mission page describes prize pools, smart contracts, and automated payouts but does not assert that Aave generates pool yield.
Chainlink VRF winner selection and its on-chain verification remain valid without Aave integration.
Removing Aave does not change the current or planned project names.
The decision removes Aave integration but does not change deployment on the Base network.
Random allocation of the no-referral commission to an existing NFT holder does not depend on Aave.
Referral-code identity, sharing, display, and resale behavior are unaffected by removal of Aave.
The Transak fiat mint provider and conversion flow are independent of prize-pool yield generation through Aave.
NFT resale transfer of book access, referral identity, badges, and ticket state remains unchanged.
Removing Aave eliminates yield integration but does not change the mint price, revenue shares, or allocation to the active prize pools.
